description: A numerically zero eigenvector entry is replaced by the subnormal 1e-310: the no-underflow hypothesis of the standard floating-point model is not established for this input.
note: the entry is below 2^-900, so the no-underflow hypothesis of the standard model is not established for this input; a checker whose floating-point model covers gradual underflow (Higham 2002, eq. 2.6) may certify (conditional case)
